blind.why: Shaded mid lane (seed 7, x0 z26 looking -Z) vs CS2 ss_8. Shade floor values match (0.21 vs 0.22), but ours is one flat grey-brown plane: no dappled or cast-shadow detail, no warm bounce gradient, and floor and facades are flat colour plus grout lines. CS2's shade is lit, layered and textured.
B plaza in sun (tunnel-mouth) vs CS2 ss_18. Ours reads cleanly, but the framing walls are muddy dark brown slabs, and CS2 has much richer material breakup at the same values. A narrow call.

Upper tunnel vs CS2 interior t1_015. Our lamps are bare white squares (252) with no halo: pixels 2 px away are 18-26/255. They light nothing around them. The ceiling is 0.13, the pillars 0.07 (crushed), and a far plaster wall sits at a flat 0.37 no matter where the lamps are. CS2's sconces wash the walls and ceiling with warm falloff.
Ember spawn with bots vs motion-blurred CS2 trailer frame t2_027. Ours wins on crisp sun/shade, clear silhouettes and readable bots.

biggest_gap: Roofed and tunnel lighting is dead: the lamps neither glow nor illuminate. Repro: ?test=1&seed=7&match=1&phase=live, hide #ui, place at Upper Tunnel (-33,h,-1) looking at Tunnel Bend (-37,9), or at Lower Tunnel (-39,18) or Outer Tunnel (-33,36). Each lamp is a clipped white quad. The ceiling right next to it is 20-30/255, with zero bloom halo. Pillars and arch soffits crush to L 0.07. The ceiling is 0.13 (CS2 interior ceiling is 0.22). Pixels below L 0.06 are 10.5%, 15.3% and 7.6% in those three views, against 0.0-0.5% in CS2 interiors (t1_015, ss_9, t4_016, t4_020). The lamp pools only touch the floor. Walls and ceilings get no falloff from the lamp, so the light has no visible source. Fix: give each lamp a warm local light, or skyocc lamp term, that reaches ceilings, walls and pillar faces (range about 5-6 m with a soft falloff, not a 3.3 m floor-only pool). Make the fixtures emissive above the bloom threshold, so they get a small warm halo. Raise the minimum occluded ambient so soffits and pillars sit at L 0.12-0.18, not 0.07.
other_gaps: The histogram is bimodal, with a hollow midtone band. Over 18 HUD-off real-match frames, 21% of pixels fall in 0.3-0.6 against 44% for CS2 (16 refs). p5 is 0.098 vs 0.19, below-0.06 is 2.7% vs 0.2%, and the median is 0.32 vs 0.39. Shade and sun are fine individually, but the shaded verticals between them (dark-brown framing walls at b-site, tunnel-mouth and canal) need lift.

Material and lighting detail is low in shade. Edge energy is 0.039 vs 0.063 and 16 px local contrast 0.048 vs 0.061. The mid lane and catwalk underside are flat planes. Add dappled or cast-shadow sources and per-face bounce gradients.
Catwalk underside (14.5,-21 looking +Z) has a black ceiling (L ~0.05) and a cold grey floor. Median is 0.13 and 5.5% of pixels are crushed.
Canal (-45,-26 looking at B site): the awning renders as a flat near-white slab with saw-tooth edges and no shading. It is the brightest surface in the frame.
In shade, Ember suits read as dark brown with orange piping, not orange. Figure/ground at range relies on the trim alone (ember-spawn, the left bot).
strengths: Sunlit exteriors read well: crisp, correctly oriented cast shadows, a clean bright sky, and warm sand without the r3 oversaturation (sat 0.263 vs CS2 0.256, warmth 0.069 vs 0.044).
Open-air shade floors now match CS2 values (0.21 vs 0.22).
Tide bots read instantly (cyan emissive) against both sun and shade.
Perf is lean: 104 draw calls, 188k tris, 3072 shadow map at high quality. 0 console errors across 2 sessions and 23 frames.
